profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary: I am a driven and analytical full stack engineer who genuinely enjoys the challenges of software development.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Full Stack Senior Software Engineer working at a data-centric construction safety risk-management company. I’ve had the opportunity to work on several different teams, including:

• Mobile app team member, building an offline-first hybrid mobile app using the Ionic Framework. The app is designed to allow Field Inspectors and Supervisors to seamlessly perform their work on job sites with limited or intermittent network connection. Along with front end development, I’ve been responsible for building out our company’s public API, which our app entirely relies upon. 

• Network team lead, supporting and building out additional functionality for our external contractor search tool. Implemented initial SEO integration with company consultant. 

• Billing team member, addressing various billing bugs and implementing additional integrations with Stripe to support new payment types and richer data collection.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Full stack software engineer working on large program for external customer. Application was designed for resource-constrained environment where speed of data processing and clarity of presentation was critical. As part of SDLC, wrote extensive automated End to End, Integration, and Unit tests. Translated complex customer technical documents into engineering specifications, and directly interfaced with customer to clarify requirements and present completed work.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Full stack engineer on an internal applications and tools teams supporting various business and engineering organizations. As part of this team, I worked on creating a new part data management system search tool on top of a legacy database, procured and implemented a COTS asset tracking tool, and performed various Oracle database administration and architecture tasks.

positions.title: Stress Analyst
positions.description: Interned on the F-35 Joint Strike Fighter stress analysis team, performing analysis using classical and computer aided techniques for production aircraft parts.

educations.schoolName: California Polytechnic State University-San Luis Obispo
